title: The Firestorm Over a Rape Allegation at Cornell
body_text:
An alleged campus sexual assault at Cornell University has gripped the country and ignited a national debate over consent.
Debra Kamin, an investigative reporter for The New York Times, explains what we know about what happened.
Guest: Debra Kamin, an investigative reporter for the The New York Times.
Background reading: 

Documents reviewed by The Times reveal how a Cornell student went from shame to action.
A Cornell police report omitted the student’s claim that she was raped.

Photo: Heather Ainsworth for The New York Times
